# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 03 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Policy Update: 15-Month Wait-Out Period Removed

- **Government scraps 15-month wait-out period for private home owners buying HDB resale flats** - The rule requiring eligible private residential property owners to wait 15 months before purchasing an HDB resale flat has been removed with immediate effect, following signs of stabilisation in the HDB resale market after years of rapid price growth. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/15-month-period-removed-for-private-property-owners-buying-hdb-resale/)

- **Survey profiles the typical million-dollar HDB resale buyer** - A PropNex survey of 110 million-dollar HDB resale transactions in 2025 found the typical buyer is a PMET professional in their 30s or 40s, or a retiree downsizing from private property, with many paying no cash-over-valuation. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/a-new-survey-reveals-the-typical-million-dollar-hdb-buyer-in-singapore-including-a-surprising-buying-trend/)

## New Launch: Dunearn House at Turf City

- **Dunearn House sells 212 units at S$3,140 psf average on launch weekend** - The 380-unit development, the first private residential project within the upcoming Bukit Timah Turf City precinct, moved 56% of its units over its launch weekend, with family-sized homes leading demand. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/dunearn-house-sells-212-units-averaging-3140-psf-at-launch/)

- **Commentary questions whether Dunearn House's 56% take-up rate met expectations** - Despite approximately 5,900 visitors at the preview weekend, PropertySoul characterises the 212 units sold as a disappointment for a highly anticipated project. [Source](https://www.propertysoul.com/2026/08/02/dunearn-house/)

## Industry & Market Updates

- **CEA introduces minimum transaction requirement for property agents from 2027** - From 1 January 2027, property agents must complete at least three qualifying transactions over a three-year registration period or pass an assessment; CEA is also extending registration periods to three years. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/property-agents-must-meet-new-transaction-requirement-from-2027-cea-extends-registrations-to-three-years/)

- **Condo resale volumes picked up in June 2026 with prices holding largely flat** - Singapore's private resale condominium market saw transaction volumes rebound in June 2026 while prices remained broadly stable, pointing to a period of stabilisation in the secondary market. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-volumes-rebounded-in-june-2026-as-buyers-returned-to-the-secondary-market/)
